- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips on how to declutter and organize living space quickly and efficiently:
  1. Set a timer.
  2. Start small.
  3. Sort into categories: Keep, Donate/Sell, Toss.
  4. Purge paper clutter.
  5. Utilize storage containers.
  6. Designate a "launching pad."
  7. Keep frequently used items accessible.
  8. Don't forget hidden areas.
  9. Get help if needed.
  10. Take breaks and reward yourself.
